include_directories(${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/ntoskrnl/include)

# The usbccgp .c bodies are replaced by Rust (usbccgp-rust). .c files kept on disk (never-delete).
# Bar: link-clean x3 (NOT boot-loaded in smoke -- boots from CD/ramdisk, not USB).

# usbccgp.sys is all Rust (usbccgp-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/usbccgp-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
add_cargo_module(usbccgp usbccgp-cargo usbccgp.sys
    KIND kernelmodedriver
    BODY_CRATE usbccgp-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32/drivers
    NO_CAB
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
